description: Grid interconnection queue depth (DC Hub): queued generation GW per US ISO, how congested the queue is, and ERCOT's large-load (data-center) queue. Omit iso for an all-ISO snapshot; pass iso for per-project rows on one grid. Keyless calls return a preview.

iso.description: ISO/RTO grid region, e.g. ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE; omit for the all-ISO snapshot

name: dchub_get_interconnection_queue
